name: idle
role: Channel inactive; normal editor actor behavior

name: palette_latched
role: Set when selecting/picking up a firework for this actor family; gates palette voice and changes hit-test behavior

name: placement_queued
role: CompleteFireworksEditorAction stores pending row/column and enters this state after placement release

name: placement_commit
role: DrawFireworksEditor commits PlaceFireworkGridItem(commit=1), clears channel to 0, then checks for full 18-cell grid

name: dormant_legacy_motion
role: Retail DrawFireworksEditor contains animation/motion code for this state, but exhaustive writes to the two state globals find no writer of value 12
